provenance.l: STS-93 Space Shuttle Mission Report (NASA, 1999): deorbit burn 209:02:19:00.1 GMT, 133.6 s, 134.4 ft/s; entry interface 209:02:48:47.7; major mode change 305 at 209:03:13:59; main gear 209:03:20:36 on SLF concrete runway 33 at 2,695.7 ft, 195.0 KEAS; nose gear 5,457.4 ft; brakes at 117.2 kt, 32.48 s; rollout 6,776.9 ft in 43.29 s; drag chute deployed and jettisoned; wheels stop 209:03:21:19; no blackout (TDRS). Launch 204:04:30:59.984 GMT. The report's text puts the chute at 03:20:48 and wheels stop at 03:21:22, its event table at 03:20:37.1 and 03:21:19; the table is used. Wheels stop = main gear 2,695.7 ft + rollout 6,776.9 ft
Entry, TAEM and Approach/Landing Guidance Workbook 21002 (2006): TAEM at about Mach 2.5, 60 n mi, 83 kft; 20 deg outer and 1.5 deg inner glideslopes, preflare about 2,000 ft
Wikipedia, Shuttle Landing Facility: runway 15/33, 15,000 ft (4,572 m) by 300 ft (91 m), concrete
